title: Donald Hornig listed as present at Kecksburg

tellings.quote: And I discovered that I had found a document about the Kexsburg UFO, and Donald Horn was listed as being present.

plain: A government summary of the 1965 Kecksburg incident, in which an object is said to have come down in the woods near Kecksburg, Pennsylvania, lists Donald Hornig, a senior science adviser to the US government, as present at the scene. The physicist Kevin Knuth says he found this himself: "Donald Hornig was listed as being present," he says, linking the find to the Hornig family, including Lily Hornig. If true, it would put a top government scientist at a crash site that is officially played down.
